name: cloze_cued
_unique_because: The cue supplies the lemma and 'yesterday' forces the tense, so MORPHOLOGY decides the filler, not meaning. Without the cue this slot admits walked, drove, ran, cycled and got — which is what the original fixture did, and it would have made a correct probe look over-generous.

item.prompt_text: Tap the word that is wrong.

item.answer: I forgot my keys and had to wait outside

name: listening_gap
_unique_because: A present-time adverbial ('these days') blocks past tense, and third-person singular forces doesn't. 'does not' is the same equivalence class; 'didn't' is excluded by the adverbial; 'don't' is an agreement error.
_rejected_alternative: "I've been waiting here ___ eight" -> since. Defensible (perfect + point-in-time obliges since, for takes a duration) but 'from eight' is used by enough speakers that the probe may return it as a second class. Recorded rather than left to fail at the terminal.

name: collocation_pick
_unique_because: 'take a photo' is fixed; 'make a photo' and 'do a photo' are not English. The fixture this replaces was 'I need to ___ a decision.' with make/do/take — and 'take a decision' is correct British English, so it was PRD §4c's own have/take-a-shower case sitting in the valid set of the very type §4c wrote the probe for.
